This was to reduce the volume of contents shared online by protesters. I have gotten a way out of this metered network. If you are into tech, you must have known about this. The throttling is caused by the network DNS. You can navigate to your network settings and change your DNS to Adguard DNS or Google DNS. I expect banks techs to do this and save customers from all this complain of slow network in the bank. For mobile phones, I was able to figure it out when you connect to a hotspot/wifi. Press and hold your wifi icon till it open your wifi network settings. Tap on your connected wifi and tap on manage/Edit. On IP SERVICES, change it to static. Scroll down to DNS1 & DNS2 and change the values to Google DNS 8.8.4.4 8.8.8.8 OR ADGUARD DNS 1.1.1.1 1.0.0.1 ADGUARD DNS ALL THE WAY THOUGH. more ↓
